text:
A horizontal force pulls a box along a horizontal surface.
The box gains 30J of kinetic energy and 10J of thermal energy is produced by the friction
between the box and the surface.
How much work is done by the force?
A
10J
B
20J
C
30J
D
40J
subject: Physics
